title: New workflow authoring through the installed workspace
summary: Continue the newly saved scratch workflow through type rejection, layout persistence, zoom and concurrent-save protection. No process execution or engineering review.

manualSteps.label: Workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated workspace and click Workflows.

manualSteps.label: New workflow
manualSteps.instruction: Choose Workflow files, then New workflow.

manualSteps.label: Author
manualSteps.instruction: Read the creation instructions, provide a name and create the verification workflow.

steps.label: Compact keyboard and scale
steps.summary: Measured visual viewport scale is 2; view selector, Fit control and keyboard-selected input inspector are available.
steps.action: Use a 720 by 550 viewport at two-times page scale, then select Text input with Enter.
steps.expected: Compact view and keyboard inspector remain available.
steps.actual: Measured visual viewport scale is 2; view selector, Fit control and keyboard-selected input inspector are available.

steps.label: Concurrent save protects both edits
steps.summary: A real 409 conflict preserves the 102 mm local edit and the 101 mm concurrent saved edit.
steps.action: Change local specimen text, update the same scratch source through its real CAS endpoint, then Save.
steps.expected: Conflict retains local text and does not overwrite the other saved edit.
steps.actual: A real 409 conflict preserves the 102 mm local edit and the 101 mm concurrent saved edit.
